title: Using Jev to generate pixel art
author: RealAstropulse
selftext:
I built a little harness that uses deepseek to create a plan, then jev to render and refine everything.

  
Jev does most of the heavy per-pixel lifting so it's \*kinda\* cost effective.

  
I don't think the results are all that great but its still neat that it works at all. Jev is clearly a very useful type of model and I'm excited to find even more cool things to do with it.
